subject: re: Road Rules Query
author: Xandu
body:
The difference is that offline Road Rules is a set of scores set by Criterion for you to beat. I dont think any of the names are real gamertags. In online road rules you compete for the best time with everyone on your friendslist. If you are lucky like me you have a couple of friends that always must rule all 64 roads... so when I have beaten 10 of them, next time I get online they will all be beaten by the same person 😃

You easily select online Time road rule by pressing up on your d-pad twice (or four times for online showtime).

-- The Creator --
